messages:
elaine_fin: Quick one — Nimbus Labs sent INV-50123 for $15,120 but AP auto-flagged: no PO and vendor SAP vendor code mismatch. They say this covers 3 SOWs consolidated + a shipping fee. Need routing.

 tom_proc: Please add invoice PDF. If it's 3 SOWs we either need three PO refs or a manual allocation. Did procurement ever issue separate POs?

 rachel_ap: AP log: `MATCH_FAIL: no PO_on_invoice; vendor_code_mismatch: invoice=VN-9001 vs SAP=VN-9007`. Also line totals map to three internal projects but no PO refs.

 devon_eng: Work delivered under SOWs alpha/beta/gamma. Procurement only created PO-1102 for alpha. Beta/gamma were small change orders but not PO'd due to emergency onboarding.

 tom_proc: Options: ask vendor to reissue with PO-1102/PO-1103/PO-1104 (preferred) OR move to Non-PO Exception with GL allocations. For payrun Thurs, recommend Non-PO Exception now and request vendor reissue for audit trail.

 procure-bot: Ticket PR-5012 created: "Nimbus INV-50123 - missing PO refs + vendor code mismatch" assigned to procurement-queue.

 ap-system: Invoice INV-50123 moved to Non-PO Exception. Hold timer 48h. Please attach acceptance emails and GL allocation to PR-5012.

 rachel_ap: Provisional GL split: alpha->GL 5801 (R&D), beta->GL 5803 (integration), gamma->GL 5805 (platform); freight split pro-rata. Approver: rachel_ap.

 elaine_fin: I'll message vendor for reissue and vendor code correction. If they can't reissue by EOD Wednesday, proceed with manual split per Rachel. :thumbsup:

 tom_proc: Following up with procurement to retro-issue PO-1103/1104 and update PR-5012. Will mark PR when POs created.

 devon_eng: attaching acceptance emails to PR-5012 now.

 elaine_fin: Closing loop once PR-5012 has either vendor reissue or payment record. Thanks everyone.
